end.line: The holy physicians who healed without payment.

feed.caption:
The week ahead, November 1 – 7 (New Calendar): saints and fasting at a glance.

We begin with the 22nd Sunday after Pentecost, when we also remember the Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Asia, physicians who healed without charge in the Name of Christ.

Wednesday and Friday are fast days. Through the week we remember the Martyrs Acindynus, Pegasius and their companions, the Venerable Joannicius the Great, the Martyrs Galacteon and Epistemis, St Paul the Confessor of Constantinople, and St Hieron and the 33 Martyrs of Melitene.

Coming next: the Synaxis of the Holy Unmercenaries on Sunday, November 8.
